title: Your First Weekend at Illinois State University, Shared as Cards
description: A two-day, under-21-safe sequence for learning campus landmarks, finding useful student spaces, and exploring nearby Uptown Normal.

cards.title: Start Saturday on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Center of campus
cards.notes: Begin between College Avenue and Beaufort Street, then use the surrounding academic buildings to orient yourself before the day gets busy.
cards.short_summary: Use ISU’s central green as your first campus compass point.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State University identifies the Quad as an open space at the center of campus, bounded by College Avenue, University Street, Beaufort Street, and School Street.
cards.access_notes: The official campus map describes the Quad as an open central space; scheduled events may affect portions of it.

cards.title: Find the Old Main Bell
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · On the Quad
cards.notes: Look for the preserved bell while crossing the Quad, and use it as a memorable landmark for retracing your route later in the semester.
cards.short_summary: Connect the present-day Quad to the university’s first building.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State University states that the bell from Old Main’s clock tower remains on the Quad and marks the former building’s location.
cards.source_title: About Illinois State University | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: The bell is an outdoor landmark on the Quad; observe any temporary event boundaries or maintenance closures.

cards.title: Take a Tree-Finding Walk
cards.subtitle: Late Saturday morning · Across the ISU campus
cards.notes: Open the arboretum’s tree map and identify a few labeled species as you walk; keep the route short enough to leave time for indoor stops.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus walk into a self-guided introduction to ISU’s living collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Fell Arboretum as a 490-acre site with thousands of trees representing more than 225 species and provides online and downloadable tree maps.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus-wide collection; use the official tree map and follow posted restrictions around work areas.

cards.title: Map Out Milner Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · College Avenue
cards.notes: Enter through the main building and locate the service desk, quiet-study rooms, group spaces, printers, and scanners before coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: Learn where Milner’s practical study resources are located.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner Library’s official floor guide documents six floors with public study areas, collaboration stations, computers, scanners, print stations, and quiet-study rooms.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Weekend access varies by term. Consult the library’s current hours page before going; some specialized spaces have separate access rules.

cards.title: Choose a Home Base at the Bone
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 200 N. University Street
cards.notes: Walk the public floors, note the Dietz Welcome Desk, and choose a lounge that could work for future meetups, meals, or study breaks.
cards.short_summary: Identify a dependable campus meeting point and indoor reset space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bone Student Center says every floor has lounge spaces for studying, relaxing, socializing, or dining, and that those lounges are open to anyone.
cards.access_notes: Building, shop, restaurant, and event hours vary. Check the center’s current hours and event notices before visiting.

cards.title: End Saturday with a Game
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Beside Bone Student Center
cards.notes: Bring your Redbird Card, ask staff what activities are available, and confirm rates or membership coverage before selecting bowling or gaming.
cards.short_summary: Close the first day with a structured indoor recreation stop.
cards.evidence_claim: ISU Campus Recreation publishes Fall 2026 weekend hours of noon–11 p.m. for the Redbird Game Complex and its main gaming area.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours by Semester | Campus Recreation | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 hours list Saturday and Sunday from noon to 11 p.m. Access, identification, activity availability, and charges may vary.

cards.entity_name: Student Fitness Center and McCormick Hall
cards.title: Preview Your Recreation Options
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · West end of the Quad
cards.notes: Bring your Redbird Card, ask for a facility overview at the lobby welcome center, and note which spaces require waivers or reservations.
cards.short_summary: Learn the layout before attempting a full workout or recreation session.
cards.evidence_claim: ISU describes the 170,000-square-foot Student Fitness Center and McCormick Hall as housing Campus Recreation and offering sport courts, a track, pool, climbing wall, and fitness areas.
cards.source_title: Student Fitness Center | Campus Recreation | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation membership, Redbird Card, and waiver requirements may apply. Check semester hours and individual-area schedules first.

cards.title: Follow Constitution Trail Toward Uptown
cards.subtitle: Sunday midday · Normal trail network
cards.notes: Choose a short out-and-back segment, stay on the marked paved route, and save the Town’s trail map before leaving campus Wi-Fi coverage.
cards.short_summary: Use a public trail segment to connect campus exploration with Normal.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Normal says Constitution Trail extends through the Twin Cities, offers numerous connections and trailheads, and is available for all to enjoy.
cards.source_title: Constitution Trail | Normal, IL - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Use the Town’s official map and obey posted trail rules. Conditions, maintenance, and temporary closures can affect access.

cards.entity_name: University Galleries of Illinois State University
cards.title: See the Current Gallery Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · 11 Uptown Circle, Suite 103
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, spend time with one complete gallery room, and read the accompanying labels before moving through Uptown.
cards.short_summary: Add a focused contemporary-art stop to the weekend sequence.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries states that it is open seven days a week year-round and that admission to all exhibitions and events is free to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days year-round according to the gallery; confirm current exhibition dates and daily visiting hours before departure.

cards.title: Finish at Uptown Circle
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · Uptown Normal
cards.notes: Pause in the roundabout’s minipark, identify Uptown Station and the route back toward campus, then set a clear return plan before dusk.
cards.short_summary: End with an outdoor landmark that ties Uptown’s destinations together.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Normal’s 2026 visitor guide identifies Uptown Circle as a minipark inside the roundabout and Uptown Station at 11 Uptown Circle.
cards.source_title: Uptown Normal Visitor Guide | Town of Normal
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor minipark within a traffic roundabout. Use designated pedestrian approaches and remain attentive near vehicle lanes.
